reason: Rs 5,000 is small money, but I've heard 'money back if it doesn't work' before and then spent weeks chasing a refund. Some developer I don't know saying a WhatsApp bot will quote my chemicals right? I'll wait and see.
objection: My rates change every day and half my quotes depend on the customer, the quantity and freight. I don't believe a system gets 7 out of 10 right without me fixing them, and if it fails I'm the one who wasted two weeks loading my price list and explaining everything.
would_change_my_mind: Speaking directly to that chemical trading company owner and seeing it draft a correct quote from my own price list on a real enquiry before I pay anything.
